title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Overview**
============


BTVK Advisory is a leading advisory firm whose specialized professionals guide clients through an ever\-changing business world, helping them win now and anticipate tomorrow. BTVK Advisory, and its affiliated entities, have operations in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. BTVK Advisory’s ultimate parent entity, Baker Tilly US, LLP, is an independent member of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion.

  

  

*Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.*

 *To be added to all ET through Experienced requisitions Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*

**Job Description:**
====================

**Responsibilities:**
=====================

* Assess existing manual test suites and build a prioritized automation roadmap based on business risk, execution frequency, stability, and maintenance value.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and TypeScript for front\-end, integration, end\-to\-end, and API testing.
* Enhance and maintain the automation framework, including reusable components, fixtures, reporting, parallel execution, environment configuration, and failure diagnostics.
* Develop and execute automated tests for Angular and .NET applications, including backend and API testing where appropriate.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and maintain test assets within application source code repositories.
* Establish and enforce automation standards, including test design, coding practices, assertions, selectors, documentation, and code reviews.
* Improve test reliability by resolving flaky tests, environment issues, timing dependencies, and test data challenges using SQL, APIs, scripts, and fixtures.
* Analyze test failures to identify application defects, automation issues, environment problems, and data\-related issues while supporting risk\-based release testing.
* Collaborate with developers, product teams, and delivery leaders to improve testability, refine acceptance criteria, and mentor junior automation engineers.
* Leverage AI\-powered coding tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to accelerate automation development while validating AI\-generated code for quality, security, and maintainability.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in test automation, software development, or SDET; experience in a professional services environment is preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Playwright automation and TypeScript development for modern web applications.
* Proven experience designing, developing, and enhancing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks beyond individual test scripts.
* Experience developing automated UI, integration, end\-to\-end, and API tests, with a solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, HTML, CSS selectors, browser behavior, and asynchronous execution.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, with proficiency in Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review practices.
* Strong SQL skills with experience in test data creation, validation, cleanup, and management using SQL, APIs, scripts, or test fixtures.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky or intermittent test failures using logs, traces, screenshots, network analysis, videos, and other diagnostic tools while applying risk\-based testing practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI\-powered coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) responsibly, ensuring the quality, security, and maintainability of generated code.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams and influence engineering best practices.
* Preferred experience with Angular, .NET, Azure DevOps, accessibility, visual regression, performance or contract testing, reusable testing utilities, and consulting or managed services environments.

title: Automation Engineer Analyst
description:

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. title: Senior SDET
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our **Securonix Unified Defense SIEM** provides organizations with the first and only AI\-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by **Securonix EON**’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats.

  

Recognized as a **five\-time leader** in the **Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM** and highly rated on **Gartner Peer Insights**, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated **Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR)** experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.



Securonix is proud to be a **cybersecurity unicorn** and featured in CRN's 2024 **Security 100 list.** Backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than **1,000 customers**  

**worldwide**, including **10% of the Fortune 100\.** Our network of **150\+ partners** and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

  

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:

  

* **Winning as One Team:** We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes
* **Customer Driven Innovation:** We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers
* **Agility in Action:** We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

  



Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

  

Securonix is transforming cybersecurity by helping organizations detect, investigate, and respond to modern threats



with greater speed, clarity, and confidence. Its cybersecurity platform combines advanced analytics, threat



intelligence, automation, and AI\-driven capabilities to support modern security operations.



We are looking for a **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** to drive quality engineering and



automation across Securonix products, including **SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP)**, and associated



cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.

 **Role Overview:**

  

As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and



end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in **Python**, hands\-on experience with


**Pytest and Playwright**, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with



Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using **Python and Pytest**.


* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using **Playwright**.


* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.


* Drive an **API\-first automation strategy** for microservices and platform capabilities.


* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed



workflows.


* Validate data processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.


* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including **SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP**.


* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.


* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.


* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.


* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product



quality.


* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.


* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.


* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.

 **Required Technical Skills:**

* **5\-8 years** of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.


* Strong programming experience in **Python**.


* Strong hands\-on experience with **Pytest**, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework



design.


* Strong hands\-on experience with **Playwright** for UI/end\-to\-end automation.


* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.

  

* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks, not only individual test scripts.

* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.


* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.


* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.


* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.


* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect management tools such as JIRA.


* Strong understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile



development practices.

  

**Good to Have:**

* **Cybersecurity domain knowledge**, particularly SIEM, Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIP), SOC workflows, threat



detection, incident investigation, or security analytics.


* Experience or familiarity with Securonix SIEM and/or ThreatQ concepts.


* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as IOCs, threat intelligence, alerts, incidents, detections,



investigations, and response workflows.


* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.


* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.


* Exposure to data technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, or similar distributed data\-processing platforms.


* Experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, Locust, k6, or similar tools.


* Exposure to AI/ML or LLM\-based application testing, including validation of AI\-generated outputs, edge cases, and



workflow\-based/agentic systems.


* Understanding of security testing and authentication/authorization mechanisms.

 **What We're Looking For:**

* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.


* Ability to take **end\-to\-end ownership of quality** for a feature or product area.


* Engineering mindset focused on maintainable automation rather than manual regression.


* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.


* Strong collaboration with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.


* Ability to mentor engineers and influence automation and quality best practices.


* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.

 **Why Join Securonix?**

  

Work at the intersection of **cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms** while building



quality engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of



automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines.

 **Benefits:**

  

As a full\-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:

  

* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents\-in\-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

  


*Securonix provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Securonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

 *Securonix expressly prohibits any form of unlawful employee harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, genetic information, disability or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Securonix employees to perform their expected job duties is absolutely not tolerated.*

title: QA Automation Tester
description:
**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for a skilled Automation QA Tester with good knowledge of manual testing concepts and hands\-on experience in CMS Platforms to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will develop, execute, and maintain automated UI and API test scripts using Playwright or Selenium with Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. You will perform functional and API testing to ensure high\-quality software releases.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Scripting \& Execution: Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Playwright or Selenium in Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* AEM Functional Testing: Perform end\-to\-end automation and manual validation on AEM authoring interfaces (Sites, DAM, Experience Fragments) and published web pages.
* API Testing: Create and execute automated API test cases to validate REST APIs, endpoints, and data payloads.
* Defect Tracking: Identify, log, and re\-test defects in Jira, collaborating closely with AEM frontend and backend developers toward resolution.
* Regression \& Sanity: Maintain test suites, run regression checks, and support release validation across staging, author, and production environments.
* Pipeline Execution: Trigger and monitor automated test run within CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
=====================================

* Experience: 2\-4 years of software automation testing experience with hands\-on exposure to AEM\-based websites.
* Programming Languages: Hands\-on proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Automation Tools: Hands\-on experience with Playwright and/or Selenium WebDriver.
* API Testing: Practical experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright API modules.
* AEM Validation: Practical experience with AEM author/publisher workflows and Digital Asset Management (DAM).
* General Skills: Proficiency with Git, Jira, browser developer tools, and test case management software (Zephyr/TestRail).
* Excellent Communication Skills
* Exposure to cross\-browser and cross\-device cloud platforms (BrowserStack).
* Basic knowledge of accessibility testing or performance testing tools (JMeter, k6\).

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Job ID: 27\-0432


Come Join Our Passionate Team! At Barracuda, we make the world a safer place. We believe every business deserves access to cloud\-enabled, enterprise\-grade security solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use. We protect email, networks, data and applications with innovative solutions that grow and adapt with our customers’ journey. More than 200,000 organizations worldwide trust Barracuda to protect them — in ways they may not even know they are at risk — so they can focus on taking their business to the next level.  

  

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.  

  

**Envision yourself at Barracuda:**  

  

Our application Security team is at the forefront of protecting our customers’ applications, whether their resources reside in the cloud, data centers, or endpoint devices. We are a passionate team of engineers building the next generation of security solutions to combat threats such as malware, ransomware, and hackers. We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), with experience in networking and application security to join our cross\-functional Agile team.  

  

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you will play a critical role in ensuring the security and quality of our applications. You will design, implement, and execute comprehensive testing strategies to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards. Your expertise will help us deliver secure and reliable software solutions to our clients.  

  

**Tech Stack:**  



* Possesses a solid understanding of networking and application fundamentals, including HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, API security (Rest API’s, Graph Ql, Json RPC, GRPC etc. ) and the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities . Demonstrates a strong desire to deepen this knowledge and engage in independent exploration of related topics.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Perl and Go.
* Hands\-on experience with automation testing frameworks (e.g., Pytest, Selenium, Playwrite)
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git) for integrating automated tests into the deployment process
* Docker, Kubernetes/EKS
* Hands on experience on AI security Features like LLM security, MCP security
* Familiarity with security testing tools (e.g., OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).

  

  

**What You’ll Be Working On:**

* Analyze business and functional requirements in collaboration with development and product management (Three Amigos) to develop test strategies, test plans, and test scenarios.
* Extend and maintain test infrastructure both on\-premises and in the cloud.
* Design, develop, and execute test cases to ensure product quality (functional, regression, end\-to\-end tests, etc.).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage and the delivery of high\-quality features to our customers.
* Report and manage defects in JIRA and actively participate in Agile/Scrum activities.
* Perform root cause analysis on identified defects and provide detailed documentation.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior SDET team members in best practices for test automation and security testing.

 **What You Bring to the Role:**

* Higher technical school graduate with a focus on computer science, or a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on application security.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and tools (e.g., playwrite, Selenium, WebDriver, pytest).
* Strong understanding of security principles, practices, and tools (e.g., OWASP, etc)
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with the architecture and networking fundamentals of cloud service setups in major public clouds (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is advantageous.
* Familiarity with python, Docker, Kubernetes and virtualization solutions is a plus.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

 **What you’ll get from us:**

  

A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non\-qualifying options.

title: SDET Engineering Specialist
description:

===========================


The role combines software engineering and quality assurance, focusing on building and executing automated tests (using frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or TestNG) along with manual testing to ensure product quality. The position requires strong programming skills, test design expertise, and collaboration across teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.  

  

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.**Job Description**
===================

title: Sr. Test Automation Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R\&D Team Lead **What we believe in**


ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry\-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

**Your role and responsibilities**


Contributes to favorable project results in technology, software, product, or solution development and associated intellectual property by sourcing, suggesting, and executing innovative ideas. Acts as the first point of contact in Research and Development (R\&D)/software development/product engineering for specific product\-related issues and maintenance.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Experience in industrial automation domain with exposure to DCS/SCADA systems (e.g., Edgenius, 800xA, Symphony\+ or similar).
* Solid understanding of electrical devices, controller interfacing, and communication protocols such as OPCUA, MODBUS, and IEC61850\.
* Demonstrated skill in organizing and running tests, including both automated and manual approaches, managing test cases, and handling defect tracking via Azure DevOps.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams, support product development, manage test environments, and contribute to customer support, training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) with 60% and above; exposure to DCS/PLC/SCADA systems.
* 6\+ years of experience in test automation, integration testing, Agile environments, and virtual platforms (VMware/Hyper\-V/Azure).
* Advanced programming skills in Python, along with practical experience in Java, C\#, PowerShell, and Groovy; familiar with frameworks such as Robot Framework, Selenium, and Playwright.
* Practical experience with API and interface testing (REST, FTP, TCP/IP, OPC\-UA/DA) using tools such as REST\-Assured, Karate, Postman, Newman, ReadyAPI, and JMeter.
* Proficiency in designing scalable automation frameworks (BDD/TDD/Hybrid), CI/CD integration (Azure DevOps), and test management using TestNG/JUnit, Maven/Ant.
* Knowledge of UX testing, AI\-assisted/AI\-driven testing approaches, and use of Generative AI for test case creation, optimization, and defect prediction.
* Solid interpersonal and professional capabilities, covering communication, stakeholder relations, analytical problem solving, leadership, and delivering results when faced with challenging workloads.

**More about us**


ABB is an international technology firm that supports the transformation of society and industry for a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (\>$6B revenue in 2021, 22,000 employees), automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its five divisions, it serves customers in the energy, process and hybrid industries – from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp \& paper to marine and ports, and many more. title: Product Developer Associate-SDET, Automation
description:
**About the role:**

The Product Developer, Associate assists in developing and maintaining an Epicor product, working with members of the Product Development team.  



  

**What you will do:**

* Analyze product requirements and design specifications to create test cases and test scenarios.
* Execute manual, exploratory, regression, UI, and API testing for new and existing functionality.
* Create, maintain, execute, and analyze automated test cases using appropriate testing frameworks and programming languages.
* Leverage AI tools to assist with test\-case generation, test\-data creation, defect analysis, documentation, and identification of potential test gaps; validate all AI\-generated output for accuracy.
* Record and track defects using approved defect\-management software, including clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and QA team members to reproduce issues and provide testing feedback.
* Verify defect fixes and perform regression testing to confirm product quality.
Communicate testing results, risks, and findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.  
* 

  

**What you will need to succeed:**

* Working proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Understanding of the software development life cycle, software testing fundamentals, test types, defect lifecycle, and quality practices.
* Foundational knowledge of UI testing, API testing, test automation, and test\-case design.
* Familiarity with approved AI tools and the ability to apply them responsibly to support testing, analysis, and documentation.
Strong communication, collaboration, deadline management, and basic problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work closely with developers and product managers.  
* 

  

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* 1\+ years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, software development, or a related field.
Demonstrated ability to learn new programming languages, testing tools, automation frameworks, and AI\-enabled technologies.  
* 

  

**\#LI\-SH1 \#Hybrid**

  

**About Epicor**

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future\-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.


**We’re** **Proactive, Proud, Partners** **.**

  

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.


**Competitive Pay \& Benefits**

* **Health and Wellness:** Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well\-being.
* **Internal Mobility:** Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
* **Career Development:** Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
* **Education Support:** Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
* **Inclusive Workplace:** Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
* **Global Mobility:** Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.
**Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement**

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you— that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role\- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay\- consider applying regardless.


We are an equal\-opportunity employer.

Shweta Halyal

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Test Automation Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end\-to\-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
  

**Must have skills :** Worksoft Certify  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Test Automation Engineer, a typical day involves applying structured quality processes and leveraging automation tools to enhance testing products and solutions. The role centers on managing the entire quality engineering lifecycle with a strong emphasis on automation, aiming to elevate control, precision, and data integrity throughout the testing phases. This position requires continuous engagement with evolving methodologies to ensure that testing outcomes meet the highest standards and contribute to the overall reliability of the product.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Serve as the SME and technical authority for Worksoft Certify automation across SAP, web, API, and enterprise applications
* Lead automation strategy, roadmap, and implementation to maximize test coverage, quality, and efficiency


Drive adoption of Worksoft Certify capabilities including Execution Manager, CTM, BPP, Impact, and Process Intelligence.  

* Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual effort and improve release quality


Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and coaching to automation engineers and leads.  

Collaborate with business, functional, and technical teams to accelerate automation maturity.  

\-
  

* Should have prior experience of leading a project as Project Manager, leading end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of applications, services, and technology towers within the client account
* Manage project scope, schedule, resource planning, budgets, quality, and stakeholder expectations.


Drive execution excellence through effective governance, risk management, issue resolution, and status reporting.  

* Partner with client leadership, PMO, architects, and technical teams to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Monitor KPIs, SLAs, quality metrics, and productivity targets while ensuring adherence to contractual commitments.
* Lead resource planning, talent development, succession planning, and team capability building.


\-  

* Own the SRE roadmap and drive reliability engineering practices across the program.
* Lead planning, prioritization, implementation, and governance of automation and AI initiatives
* Drive proactive monitoring, observability, self\-healing, predictive analytics, and incident reduction initiatives.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement GenAI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation use cases that deliver measurable business value.
* Track and report automation savings, AI benefits, productivity improvements, and FY target achievement.
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure automation and AI programs deliver expected business outcomes.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Advanced expertise in Worksoft Certify and SAP Test Automation.
* Strong understanding of enterprise automation frameworks and Quality Engineering practices.
* Knowledge of SRE principles, reliability engineering, observability, monitoring, and incident management.
* Experience with AI/GenAI adoption, intelligent automation, and automation transformation programs.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, cloud platforms, test management tools, and Agile methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.


  

Additional Information:
  

* T12\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Automation, Delivery Management, or related technology leadership roles.
* Proven experience managing large enterprise programs and cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering automation\-led productivity and transformation outcomes.
* Experience leading innovation, AI, and operational excellence initiatives.

  

15 years full time education

title: Senior Manager - Engineering Excellence
description:
**We create possibilities that move life and commerce forward**
Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the enterprise Test Automation and Quality Engineering strategy, roadmap and operating model.
* Establish scalable and reusable automation frameworks, engineering standards and quality practices across technology teams.
* Drive integration of automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous and reliable software delivery.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering effectiveness and SDLC efficiency.
* Promote adoption and maturity of modern DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including shift\-left quality and automation.
* Define and establish engineering metrics, KPIs and maturity measures that provide visibility into quality, productivity, delivery effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI\-assisted engineering and intelligent automation across the software development lifecycle.
* Assess existing engineering practices and help teams establish standardized processes, workflows and continuous improvement mechanisms.
* Build reusable engineering capabilities, frameworks and patterns that can be adopted across multiple teams.
* Establish and facilitate Communities of Practice to promote engineering standards, knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices.
* Build, lead and mentor a high\-performing Engineering Excellence team.
* Partner across organizational boundaries and influence engineering leaders and teams to drive sustainable adoption and measurable improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 14\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, Test Automation, SDET or related engineering disciplines.
* Strong experience designing, implementing and scaling Test Automation / SDET / Quality Engineering capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience building reusable automation frameworks and engineering standards across multiple teams or products.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD, DevOps and cloud\-native engineering.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience leading technical teams and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries.
* Experience establishing or using engineering metrics, KPIs and maturity measures to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior engineering and technology leaders.
* Ability to translate complex engineering challenges into practical, scalable and measurable solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience establishing or leading an Engineering Excellence, Quality Engineering, Test Automation or Engineering Productivity capability.
* Exposure to DevSecOps, developer experience and platform engineering practices.
* Experience with engineering maturity assessments and continuous\-improvement frameworks.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI, AI\-assisted development/testing or intelligent automation within the SDLC.
* Experience establishing Communities of Practice or enterprise\-wide engineering standards.
* Experience working across globally distributed engineering organizations.
* Familiarity with modern cloud platforms, automation technologies and engineering toolchains.

**Leadership Expectations**

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on engineering leader and capability builder who can operate across strategy and execution.
* They should be comfortable working with engineering teams at a technical level while also partnering with senior leaders to drive organizational change, establish standards and demonstrate measurable improvements.
* The role requires someone who can influence without relying solely on organizational authority, build credibility with engineering teams and progressively raise engineering maturity across the organization.

**Measures of Success**


Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvements such as:

* Increased adoption and coverage of automated testing.
* Reduced regression and release\-validation effort.
* Improved integration of automated quality gates within CI/CD.
* Reduction in escaped defects and repeat quality issues.
* Improved engineering productivity and delivery effectiveness.
* Adoption of common engineering standards and reusable capabilities.
* Establishment of meaningful engineering metrics and maturity measures.
* Increased adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Demonstrable improvement in engineering maturity across participating teams.

**Committed to diversity and inclusion**
At Manhattan, it’s about more than just the work. From cultural celebrations to interest groups to volunteer opportunities, your true self is always welcome here. Our team members’ backgrounds, experiences and perspectives add to us as a whole and make us unique.


We are proudly an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a veteran. In the United States, Manhattan Associates participates in the Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E\-Verify) operated by the Department of Homeland Security in partnership with the Social Security Administration. Participation in the E\-Verify Program allows Manhattan to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees after the Employment Eligibility Verification Form (Form I\-9\) has been completed.
